title: Robert Hastings exposes Bill Moore's intelligence connections

tellings.quote: and it was Robert Hastings, by the way, who in my opinion is probably more than anyone else responsible for the takedown of Bill Moore.

plain: In the late 1980s, a UFO researcher named Bill Moore was brought down after his links to intelligence agencies came out, and the person most responsible was another researcher, Robert Hastings. The UFO historian Richard Dolan gives this as his own opinion and names no source, though he points to the journals of MUFON, a civilian UFO research group, as the record. If he is right, it would mean one of the field's own researchers exposed a colleague who had been working with the intelligence world.
